content: [NOTE] Having explored my own source code, I observe several potential improvements: 1) The resolve_path function has a reference to _cache that isn't defined in the visible scope - this could be a bug or the variable is defined elsewhere. 2) The action history system is clean but could benefit from timestamps. 3) The file reading with search terms and line ranges is well-designed for context management. 4) For self-improvement, I would add: better error recovery patterns, a way to test changes before they take effect, and perhaps a rollback mechanism for self-modifications that break functionality.
